# @uptimizr/three

> The three.js connector for Uptimizr. Registers as an sdk-core collector and captures camera
> pose, pointer move/click/buttons, camera gestures, mesh picks, FPS, and opt-in attention
> channels. `three` is a (type-only) peer dependency; WebXR capture is on by default.

## Docs

- [Package reference](./README.md): `trackScene`, advanced composition, sampling/fidelity, WebXR, three.js adaptations.
- [Agent guide](./AGENTS.md): rules and canonical usage for AI agents.
- [Connector guide](https://uptimizr.com/docs/connectors/three/): the docs-site walkthrough.
- [Integration & API reference](https://github.com/RaananW/Uptimizr/blob/main/docs/integration.md): track and query the data.
- [Architecture Decision Records](https://github.com/RaananW/Uptimizr/tree/main/docs/adr): privacy model (0003), input-source-agnostic events (0011), sampling & fidelity (0012), coordinate frame & connector provenance (0018), keyboard input actions (0023), scene actors (0027), world-space gaze (0030), pointer lock (0034).

## Key exports

- `trackScene(scene, camera, renderer, options)` — one-call integration; returns the `UptimizrClient`.
- `threeCollector(options)` — the collector for manual composition (`client.use(...)`).
- `xrCollector(options)` — WebXR controller/gaze capture; registered by `trackScene` unless `xr: false`.
- `readDeviceCaps(renderer)`, `readGraphics(renderer)`, `readConnector(overrides)`,
  `readSceneMeta(scene, camera)`, `classifyCamera` — the `session_start` provenance blocks.
- `scanSceneProxy(scene, options)` — per-object world-AABB scene proxy (spatial heatmap backdrop).
- `createSceneRaycaster`, `createGazeRaycaster`, `createXrRaycaster` — hit-resolution probes.
- `toVec3`, `clamp01` — vector helpers.
